items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And that's when I met Tañ Jordan at that time.

ctx.x: But I used to catch him at the Savoy, in New York,
whenever I would run up there, I'd catch him at the Savoy with his band. And that's when I met Tañ Jordan at that time.
Yeah, Tañ played with him for a little while.
